fusions.name: Opened One Eye
fusions.desc: A strike from apparent sleep that deals 22 damage to a target at or below 25% health, leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and [Leaden] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Drowsy Ruse
fusions.desc: A huge fake yawn: every enemy within 3 tiles takes a blow that deals 10 damage and nods off for 0.8 seconds. Each has a 40% chance to wake turned against its allies for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Dead to the World
fusions.desc: You go limp and vanish from notice for 8 seconds, regaining 12 health at once. Enemies notice you 70% later, you move 10% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Never Quite There
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a blow you failed to dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
